good_thing: (Virginia’s Shenandoah Valley): Retired neighboring farmers John Rice and John and Debbie Sessler are using Smithsonian science-guided practices to reconnect habitat across their farms. The Sesslers planted native seed mixes for birds, pollinators, and other wildlife, while Rice protected his land with a conservation easement. A good neighborly project can have room for more than people.
current_or_history: On August 29, 1831, Michael Faraday produced a brief electric current in one coil by passing a current through another wound on the opposite side of an iron ring. He had wound and cotton-insulated the apparatus by hand, work estimated to have taken about ten working days.
tiny_fact: A narwhal’s spiral tusk is actually a tooth that erupts from its jaw. Rarely, a narwhal has two tusks.
